investigation.title: Remote Agent Provisioning: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-24T00:27:18Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB endpoint was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first POST /api/agents call and all sibling checks share the exact same error message, the swarm gateway itself — not any individual check's logic — is the blocking dependency.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning path) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agent check depends on a successful POST /api/agents call that proxies through this gateway; because the gateway returned a 502 before any agent was created, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) could be collected, causing all three checks to fail with the same message. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability failure localized to the swarm gateway layer; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so broader production impact cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.
